name: occam-review
description: Deletion-focused simplicity review with checksum and test-scope discipline.

interface.shortDescription: Review plans and changes for unnecessary complexity.
interface.longDescription: Audit implementation plans and code changes for removable abstractions, dead public surface, redundant validation, unneeded compatibility layers, unnecessary checksums, and test-suite sprawl.
defaultPrompt: Review this implementation for unnecessary complexity after checking correctness.
Check whether these checksums and tests have real long-term consumers.
